Chat request with response_format json_object that returns valid JSON content

```rust title="Rust"
use liter_llm::LlmClient;

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() {
    let req_json: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(r#"{"messages":[{"content":"Respond with JSON only.","role":"system"},{"content":"Give me a user object with name and age fields.","role":"user"}],"model":"gpt-4","response_format":{"type":"json_object"}}"#).unwrap();
    let req = serde_json::from_value(req_json).unwrap();
    let client = liter_llm::create_client(std::env::var("API_KEY").expect("API_KEY must be set"), None, None, None, None).unwrap();
    let result = client.chat(req).await.expect("call failed");
    println!("{:?}", result.choices);
    println!("{:?}", result.choices[0].message.content);
    println!("{:?}", result.choices[0].finish_reason);
}
```
